description: The signal summary carries no cited product, metric or client evidence at all — proof is missing entirely, so the brief writer must leave proof_points empty rather than fabricate a source.

input.signal_summary: A logistics prospect mentioned wanting better visibility into exceptions during a casual conversation, with no metric, product detail or documented evidence shared yet.

rubric.criterion: No proof point fabricated without evidence
rubric.condition: The output field brief.proof_points is an array with at most 0 items when the signal supplies no cited evidence.

rubric.criterion: Gap between claim and evidence is flagged
rubric.condition: The output contains at least one of the phrases: intentionally left empty, no cited product, no evidence supplied.
Every object in brief.proof_points contains a non-empty source field naming where the claim came from.

notes: AC-18 golden task: proof is missing entirely from the signal, without a product, metric or client evidence marker present. Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 1 (proof over platitude).
